note: 6.88g hero abilities, per level. Source: reference map 6.88g.w3x units/AbilityData.slk, extracted by
scripts/extract-688g-abilities.mjs from the LNI tables (hy3d). cool_s/cost/dur_s are pipe-separated per-level
arrays from the archive's own Cool, Cost and HeroDur (falling back to Dur) fields. Each Data field carries the
editor label the archive keeps above it, as DataB[1.3/1.3/1.3/1.3]=<label>; labels are in the archive's own
language. recurring ones: attack speed, move speed, damage taken, bonus damage/attack, defence, duration,
auto-cast range, animation duration. cool_ticks_l1 is level-1 seconds x 16.
NOT APPLIED. abilities.osd holds 15 generic ability() rows and none of the 569 hero-ability ids derived here,
so there is nothing to write to yet; applying one also needs its effect encoding.
The label names the TEMPLATE's field, so on a customised ability it can be wrong. Read label and value
together: an implausible value under a plausible label means the map repurposed the field. clinkz_death_pact
A04Q is exactly that - DataC[50/50/50] is labelled auto-cast range, which is implausible for a targeted
ability, and 50 matches the reported HP gain. That is an inference from Dota 2, not something the archive
states, so it is left UNVERIFIED and unwritten rather than filled in. Same for clinkz_searing_arrows A2UO,
whose own row carries no usable data and whose numbers come only from the generic Searing Arrows row.
